business_problem: Purplle needed to support rapid 6x user growth, survive peak sale traffic, and automate search, CRM, pricing, and assortment decisions without increasing infrastructure costs or slowing down retail operations.
solution_summary: Purplle rebuilt its retail technology stack on a cloud-native Google Cloud foundation so growth in users, transactions, and AI workloads would not require proportional increases in cost. Google Kubernetes Engine forms the backbone for its customer-facing platform, with Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, and Cloud Pub/Sub supporting transactional data, object content, and event-driven messaging. On the analytical side, Purplle unified its data in BigQuery with Datastream for CDC and Managed Service for Apache Airflow for orchestration. Gemini platform speeds CRM campaigns to under an hour, while Cloud Run functions and Cloud AutoML power a self-serve pricing engine that updates every four hours. The same environment supports search, assortment planning, and operational recovery workflows, giving Purplle a single stack for retail personalization, merchandising decisions, and peak-event resilience.

data_flow: Transactions and customer events flow through GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub into BigQuery, where Datastream and Airflow keep the analytical layer current. Gemini platform uses that data for CRM campaigns, while Cloud AutoML and Cloud Run drive pricing and assortment decisions back into operational retail workflows.
